about.title: Lake Almanor Country Club, California
about.extract: Lake Almanor Country Club is a census-designated place (CDP) in Plumas County, California, United States. The population was 451 at the 2020 census, up from 419 at the 2010 census. The ZIP code for the CDP is 96137.

sites.name: Almanor Campground
sites.feeText: Overnight Use: Single Site: $18 per night
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from faucets
sites.toiletText: New Vault toilets, flush toilets in A. South
sites.about: Almanor Campground is a large family-friendly facility for individuals and large groups alike. It provides direct access to beautiful Lake Almanor and a variety of recreational opportunities in the area. Almanor North and Almanor South sit on the west shore of Lake Almanor at an elevation of 4,540…
sites.directions: From Highway 36 near Chester, travel south 5.9 miles on Highway 89 to the intersection with Lake Almanor West Drive. Continue toward Lake Almanor for about a mile. Almanor North is to the left, and…
sites.restrictions: Fee must be paid upon arrival and prior to each night of camping, Fee regulations are strictly enforced. Quiet hours are 10pm to 6am. Campfires allowed only in provided fire rings. 2 vehicles (including RVs/Boats/Etc.) and 8 persons allowed in each campsite. Pets must remain on a leash or confined…
sites.reservations: Reservations can be made by visiting Recreation.gov Reservations can be made up to 4 days in advance and can be made up to 6 months in advance for standard sites and 12 months in advance for group sites.

sites.name: Almanor Legacy Campground
sites.feeText: Overnight Use: Single Site: $30 per night Double Site: $60 per night
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from faucets
sites.about: Almanor Legacy is a developed campground about a mile from beautiful Lake Almanor. This campground features 13 single RV sites, and 1 double site. Each site is eqquipped with water and electrical hookups, two sets of hook ups are provided at double site # 11. Every site also provides a fire ring…
sites.directions: From Highway 36 near Chester, travel south 5.9 miles on Highway 89 to the intersection with Lake Almanor West Drive. Almanor Legacy Campground will be the second left, after the RV Dump Site.
sites.restrictions: Fee must be paid upon arrival and prior to each night of camping, Fee regulations are strictly enforced. Quiet hours are 10pm to 6am. Campfires allowed only in provided fire rings. 2 vehicles (including RVs/Boats/Etc.) and 8 persons allowed in each campsite. Pets must remain on a leash or confined…

sites.name: Almanor RV Dump Station
sites.feeText: There is a $5 dump station fee per use. Access pass discounts do NOT apply.

sites.name: Soldier Meadows Campground
sites.feeText: Overnight Use: Single Site: $10 per night
sites.about: Soldier Meadows is a developed campground with 15 designated sites. A maximum of 8 people is allowed per site. Located in a picturesque meadow near Soldier Creek, the campground is surrounded by a pine and fir forest. Grills and tables are provided.
sites.directions: From Highway 89, take Humbolt road until you reach the intersection with 27N78. The campground is located off of 27N78.

sites.name: Bogard Campground
sites.feeText: No fees are required for this site
sites.hours: Quiet hours are 10:00 p.m. until 6:00 a.m.
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from a hand pump
sites.about: Quiet and tucked away from the beaten path. Pine creek adjacent to campground, beautiful aspens in and around campground. Located 1.75 miles off Highway 44. No Fees. 10 sites. Hand pumped water. Vault toilets, Maximum trailer length 25 feet.

sites.name: High Bridge Campground
sites.feeText: Overnight Use: Single Site: $14 per night
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from a hand pump
sites.about: High Bridge Campground is situated where Warner Creek meets the Feather River. It is a developed campground with 12 available sites. The campgroud was heavily damaged by the 2021 Dixie Fire, and will rewmain closed until further notice.
sites.directions: From Chester, travel north on Feather River Drive for about a mile. Turn LEFT onto Chester Warner Valley Rd. Drive about 5 miles. High Bridge Campground is on the LEFT.
sites.restrictions: Include: campfires in fire rings only, all animals must be on a managed six (6) foot leash, quiet hours from 10pm to 6 am, no fireworks, must occupy site first night, and every night thereafter.

sites.name: Warner Creek
sites.feeText: Overnight Use: Single Site: $10 per night
sites.about: Warner Creek Campground is a hidden gem, nestled in a mixed conifer forest. Only 15 minutes from Chester, this semi-developed campgroiund offers plenty of shade, and fresh air. 10 sites are available, each with a picnic table and fire rings. No potable water on site.
sites.directions: From Chester, take Feather River Drive about 1 mile, then turn Left onto Chester Warner Valley Road. Drive almost 7 miles. Warner Creek Campground will be on the right,.
sites.restrictions: Include: campfires in fire rings only, all animals must be on a managed six (6) foot leash, quiet hours from 10pm to 6 am, no fireworks, must occupy site first night, and every night thereafter.

sites.name: Greenville (family Campground )
sites.feeText: Overnight Use: Single Site: $25 per night
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from faucets
sites.about: Greenville Campground provides large trees and shady sites along the banks of Wolf Creek. The campground is just minutes from Greenville, so you can easily pick up supplies in town.
sites.directions: From Greenville, travel 1 mile north on Hwy 89 to the campground.
sites.restrictions: 14 day camping limit. 6 people per campsite, 12 people for double sites. 2 vehicles per campsite. OHV riding is not allowed:. Store food, trash and scented items appropriately - Be Bear Aware.
sites.reservations: Some sites can be reserved online at Recreation.gov up to six months in advance, or by calling 1-877-444-6777.

sites.name: Domingo Springs Campground
sites.feeText: Overnight Use: Single Site: $14 per night
sites.about: Domingo Springs is a developed campground with 18 designated sites. Campfire rings and tables are provided. The local Maidu Indians referred to this spot as the "center of the universe". This campground is less than one-half mile from the Pacific Crest Trail. Water from nearby Domingo Spring is…
sites.directions: Chester, CA. From Chester, turn from Highway 36 onto the Warner Valley/Old Bluff Road and travel 8 miles northwest.
